direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-16-rcs-27765-revision-cola
direct_evidence.body:
RCS-27765. Paso siguiente, 16 de septiembre de 2026.

Qué pasa
Matthew informó, mediante el comentario interno de Rajith del 15 de septiembre, que el archivo generado contenía únicamente datos del 25 de junio. Winn-Dixie investigará si su proceso genera el archivo con el formato correcto. Jira está en Under Customer Review, prioridad Medium.

Causa
No confirmada. Appriss observó un lote mayor el 10 de septiembre que se procesó normalmente y cuya fecha de transacción más antigua fue el 2 de julio. El conteo del 25 de junio para la tienda 358 sigue en 773, sin filas nuevas. Esta diferencia no demuestra que Winn-Dixie enviara fechas equivocadas. Puede estar en la generación, formato, contenido transmitido o interpretación del lote.

direct_evidence.body:
## Nota de ventana, aplica al Transaction Vault y no al conteo

`DataApi.CutOffDate` sin configurar toma por default tres meses antes de hoy. Hoy eso cae el 14 jun y
el 25/06 todavia queda del lado bueno. Alrededor del 25 sep cruza el umbral y los drill down de
recibos del 25/06 empiezan a servirse por el fallback de Greenplum en vez del Data API. El conteo
agregado no se mueve. Lo que ve el cliente al abrir un recibo, si.

direct_evidence.title: 2026-09-14-rcs-27765-respuesta-correo-matthew
direct_evidence.body:
Heaven, Matthew,

Thank you both for setting up the resend and for letting me know the timing ahead of it.

I checked our production data for store 358 on 06/25/2026. The counts are unchanged from what I shared in July, so the transactions that were missing for that day have not reached us yet.

The resend itself did come through. A larger than usual batch landed on 09/10 and it processed normally on our side. Looking at the transaction dates inside that batch, the earliest one is 07/02/2026, so it looks like 06/25 was not part of what was rebuilt.

I may be reading this differently than your team, so I wanted to share what I am seeing rather than assume anything about how the file was put together.

Whenever you have a moment, could you have the data rebuilt so that it covers 06/25/2026 for store 358? If you let me know when it goes out, I will watch for it on our side and post the counts on the ticket once it lands.

I appreciate the work that has gone into this from your team. Please reach out any time if something looks different from where you sit.

Kind regards,

Juan Martinez

I may be reading this differently than your team, so I wanted to share what I am seeing rather than assume anything.

Whenever you and Matthew have a moment, could you have the data rebuilt so that it covers 06/25/2026 for store 358? If you let me know when it goes out, I will watch for it and post the counts here once it lands.

I appreciate all the work that has gone into this on your side. Please reach out any time if something looks different from where you sit.

Kind regards,
